rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-accredited provider programs; CPR (Red Cross/AHA, max 1 h per 24 months); programs presented or approved by the Alaska Pharmacists Association, PTCB or NPTA when directly related to pharmacy practice
rules.alternatives: Obtaining initial PTCB certification during the licensing period satisfies the CE requirement.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: instead of CE, affidavit of having read the state pharmacy statutes and regulations plus a pharmacist-in-charge affidavit verifying technician training (12 AAC 52.230).
rules.audit_note: Random audits via CPE Monitor data; certificates required for CE not reported to CPE Monitor.
rules.notes: Nationally certified technicians who administer vaccines need 1 hour of ACPE-approved immunization/vaccine CE within the 10 hours. Licenses renew biennially on a date set by the department. A technician license lapsed two years or more cannot be reinstated.

topics.who: Nationally certified technicians who administer vaccines: ACPE-approved immunization/vaccine CE, within the 10 hours
